global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Fresh green garnish and white toppings rest atop the noodles in a white bowl, set against a dark wooden table under warm, focused lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with smooth, reflective surface and subtle grain patterns visible beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions, white onions, and red ginger threads, appears rich and glossy.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, light brown meat with visible fat marbling and a slightly glossy surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as brown, slightly curled, fibrous pieces with a textured surface.
